title: Zhaojun Crosses the Frontier
synopsis: Zhaojun, one of the “Four Beauties” of ancient China, makes a vital contribution to peace between the Han Dynasty and the Xiongnu.

fullText.simplified:
昭君出塞

    中国古代有很多漂亮的女人，只有最出名的四个，才被称为“四大美人”，还分别有着“沉鱼、落雁、闭月、羞花”的美称。她们曾经改变国家的命运，有的让国家大乱，有的让国家统一。
    “四大美人”中的“落雁”，名叫王昭君，她就是汉朝人，而且，她和匈奴的国王结婚了。
     匈奴人在汉朝周围已经几百年了，由于土地不适合种地，他们就只能来抢汉朝的粮食。汉武帝派人把他们打了一顿，他们才收敛了一些。
    后来汉宣帝时期，匈奴人自己陷入了内战，五个头领都抢着要当匈奴王，谁也不服谁。而且，这些人中有的打算继续和汉朝作对，有的想和汉朝“交个朋友”，想法大不相同。交涉不了，他们就用拳头说话，打得停不下来。最后只剩下两个头领——北匈奴郅支单于和南匈奴呼韩邪单于。
    这两个派别，一个想要打汉朝，一个想要交好汉朝。可惜，想交好汉朝的南匈奴呼韩邪打不过北匈奴，所以，他决定向汉朝投降并求助。就这样，他亲自来汉朝，见到了汉宣帝。
    他的投降让汉朝上下都非常高兴。以前的匈奴多么残暴，现在终于投降了！汉宣帝热情地接待了呼韩邪，请他吃饭、玩乐，然后还派了一万六千个士兵送他回去。这么多士兵，每个都骑着马，带着礼物和粮食。在他们的帮助下，呼韩邪重新夺回了王位。
    呼韩邪非常喜欢汉朝。汉宣帝死后，他还想继续保持这样友好的关系。于是，过了几年，他又来找汉元帝，这次他诚挚地说：“我想要和汉朝公主结婚，做您的女婿。”
    汉元帝非常开心，但是他的女儿们都很小，而呼韩邪已经五十岁，公主们都不想离开繁华的汉朝，去塞外受苦，也不想和一个老头子结婚。
    汉元帝想了很久，突然想到一个好主意：“他想要一个公主，那我找一个人来做‘公主’不就好了吗？”于是，他就去问皇宫里的下人，也就是宫女，愿不愿意去塞外和匈奴王结婚。可让人诧异的是，这些宫女也不愿意去塞外——是啊，就算不是真正的公主，她们也不想去塞外受苦。
    很多天以后，汉元帝急得不行，才听说有一个宫女表示她愿意去。汉元帝十分欣慰，又十分感动。他立刻同意了这件事，并请这个宫女来见他。
    汉元帝一看到这个叫王昭君的宫女，马上就后悔了。因为这个女孩，真是太漂亮了！他有那么多妻子，那么多宫女，却没有一个比王昭君漂亮！
    那么漂亮的女孩，为什么他从来没见过呢？追究下去，汉元帝才知道，原来他自己曾经想找美人来做宫女，各地的美人都被送过来。一千多个美女，汉元帝没有时间慢慢看，就让画家给她们画画，并将画像送过来给自己选。画家谋求财富，就让美女们出钱，谁出得多，他就画得漂亮一些。大家都想得到皇帝的青睐，只好给钱给画家，只有王昭君不愿意给钱。画家不高兴了，把她画得很丑，所以汉元帝看到画像就不喜欢，从来没有见过王昭君。
    知道了画家做的坏事，汉元帝很生气，不想让王昭君去塞外了。但王昭君不愿意埋没在宫里，她说：“我愿意去和匈奴结婚，奉献出自己的一生。保护国家是男人的事，也是我们女人的事。”汉元帝虽然不舍得，但也实在找不出第二个愿意去塞外的女孩了，只能把王昭君封为“公主”，送她离开。
    在一个秋高气爽的日子里，美丽的王昭君穿着红裙子，告别故土，抱着琵琶出发了。一路上，她想到以后很难再回故土，心绪难平。于是，她骑在马上，拨动琴弦，奏起了离别之曲。南飞的大雁听到这悦耳的琴声，看到骑在马上的这个美丽女子，忘记摆动翅膀，跌落地下。所以，后来王昭君有了“落雁”的美称。
    马车经过了茫茫的大漠，经过了荒凉的草原，从冬天走到夏天，才走到了塞外，匈奴的地方。呼韩邪感谢着汉朝，一直对王昭君很好。他死了以后，他以前的儿子又按规定当了匈奴王，还和继母王昭君结了婚。
    就这样，王昭君先后和两个匈奴王结婚。她的到来，让匈奴和汉朝维持了六十年的和平。
    王昭君的善良、坚强和友好，像太阳一般照耀在匈奴的土地上。潜移默化之下，匈奴人开始学着汉朝人种田种树、养殖畜牧，过上了更好的日子。
    王昭君如此美丽，更难能可贵的是她为汉朝带来的和平稳定。她真不愧是“四大美人”之一！

    “四大美人”中的“落雁”，名叫王昭君，她就是漢朝人，而且，她和匈奴的國王結婚了。
     匈奴人在漢朝周圍已經幾百年了，由於土地不適合種地，他們就只能來搶漢朝的糧食。漢武帝派人把他們打了一頓，他們才收斂了一些。

    這兩個派別，一個想要打漢朝，一個想要交好漢朝。可惜，想交好漢朝的南匈奴呼韓邪打不過北匈奴，所以，他決定向漢朝投降並求助。就這樣，他親自來漢朝，見到了漢宣帝。
    他的投降讓漢朝上下都非常高興。以前的匈奴多麼殘暴，現在終於投降了！漢宣帝熱情地接待了呼韓邪，請他吃飯、玩樂，然後還派了一萬六千個士兵送他回去。這麼多士兵，每個都騎著馬，帶著禮物和糧食。在他們的幫助下，呼韓邪重新奪回了王位。
    呼韓邪非常喜歡漢朝。漢宣帝死後，他還想繼續保持這樣友好的關係。於是，過了幾年，他又來找漢元帝，這次他誠摯地說：“我想要和漢朝公主結婚，做您的女婿。”

    漢元帝一看到這個叫王昭君的宮女，馬上就後悔了。因為這個女孩，真是太漂亮了！他有那麼多妻子，那麼多宮女，卻沒有一個比王昭君漂亮！

    知道了畫家做的壞事，漢元帝很生氣，不想讓王昭君去塞外了。但王昭君不願意埋沒在宮裡，她說：“我願意去和匈奴結婚，奉獻出自己的一生。保護國家是男人的事，也是我們女人的事。”漢元帝雖然不捨得，但也實在找不出第二個願意去塞外的女孩了，只能把王昭君封為“公主”，送她離開。
    在一個秋高氣爽的日子裡，美麗的王昭君穿著紅裙子，告別故土，抱著琵琶出發了。一路上，她想到以後很難再回故土，心緒難平。於是，她騎在馬上，撥動琴弦，奏起了離別之曲。南飛的大雁聽到這悅耳的琴聲，看到騎在馬上的這個美麗女子，忘記擺動翅膀，跌落地下。所以，後來王昭君有了“落雁”的美稱。
    馬車經過了茫茫的大漠，經過了荒涼的草原，從冬天走到夏天，才走到了塞外，匈奴的地方。呼韓邪感謝著漢朝，一直對王昭君很好。他死了以後，他以前的兒子又按規定當了匈奴王，還和繼母王昭君結了婚。
    就這樣，王昭君先後和兩個匈奴王結婚。她的到來，讓匈奴和漢朝維持了六十年的和平。
    王昭君的善良、堅強和友好，像太陽一般照耀在匈奴的土地上。潛移默化之下，匈奴人開始學著漢朝人種田種樹、養殖畜牧，過上了更好的日子。

sentences.pinyin: hàn xuān dì rè qíng de jiē dài le hū hán yé qǐng tā chī fàn wán lè rán hòu hái pài le yí wàn liù qiān ge shì bīng sòng tā huí qù
sentences.english: His surrender made the whole Han dynasty very happy. How savage the Xiongnu used to be, and now they finally surrender!

sentences.simplified: 这么多士兵，每个都骑着马，带着礼物和粮食。在他们的帮助下，呼韩邪重新夺回了王位。
sentences.traditional: 這麼多士兵，每個都騎著馬，帶著禮物和糧食。在他們的幫助下，呼韓邪重新奪回了王位。
sentences.pinyin: zhè me duō shì bīng měi ge dōu qí zhe mǎ dài zhe lǐ wù hé liáng shi zài tā men de bāng zhù xià hū hán yé chóng xīn duó huí le wáng wèi
sentences.english: Emperor Xuan received Huhanye warmly, invited him to dinner and entertainment, and then also sent 16,000 soldiers to see him back.
There were many soldiers, each on horseback, carrying gifts and food. With their help, Huhanye regained the throne.

sentences.simplified: 呼韩邪非常喜欢汉朝。汉宣帝死后，他还想继续保持这样友好的关系。
sentences.traditional: 呼韓邪非常喜歡漢朝。漢宣帝死後，他還想繼續保持這樣友好的關係。
sentences.pinyin: hū hán yé fēi cháng xǐ huan hàn cháo hàn xuān dì sǐ hòu tā hái xiǎng jì xù bǎo chí zhè yàng yǒu hǎo de guān xi

sentences.simplified: 于是，过了几年，他又来找汉元帝，
sentences.traditional: 於是，過了幾年，他又來找漢元帝，
sentences.pinyin: yú shì guò le jǐ nián tā yòu lái zhǎo hàn yuán dì
sentences.english: Huhanye was very fond of the Han Dynasty. After the death of Emperor Xuan, he wanted to continue such friendly relations.

sentences.simplified: 这次他诚挚地说：“我想要和汉朝公主结婚，做您的女婿。”
sentences.traditional: 這次他誠摯地說：“我想要和漢朝公主結婚，做您的女婿。”
sentences.pinyin: zhè cì tā chéng zhì de shuō wǒ xiǎng yào hé hàn cháo gōng zhǔ jié hūn zuò nín de nǚ xu
sentences.english: So, after a few years, he returned to visit Emperor Yuan of Han.
This time he said sincerely, ”I want to marry a princess of the Han Dynasty and be your son-in-law.”

sentences.simplified: 汉元帝非常开心，但是他的女儿们都很小，而呼韩邪已经五十岁，
sentences.traditional: 漢元帝非常開心，但是他的女兒們都很小，而呼韓邪已經五十歲，
sentences.pinyin: hàn yuán dì fēi cháng kāi xīn dàn shì tā de nǚ ér men dōu hěn xiǎo ér hū hán yé yǐ jīng wǔ shí suì

sentences.simplified: 公主们都不想离开繁华的汉朝，去塞外受苦，
sentences.traditional: 公主們都不想離開繁華的漢朝，去塞外受苦，
sentences.pinyin: gōng zhǔ men dōu bù xiǎng lí kāi fán huá de hàn cháo qù sài wài shòu kǔ
sentences.english: Emperor Yuan was very happy, but his daughters were very young, and Huhanye was already 50 years old.

sentences.simplified: 也不想和一个老头子结婚。
sentences.traditional: 也不想和一個老頭子結婚。
sentences.pinyin: yě bù xiǎng hé yí ge lǎo tóu zi jié hūn
sentences.english: None of the princesses wanted to leave the flourishing Han Dynasty and live a hard life beyond the frontier, ..
.. nor did they want to marry an old man.

sentences.simplified: 汉元帝想了很久，突然想到一个好主意：
sentences.traditional: 漢元帝想了很久，突然想到一個好主意：
sentences.pinyin: hàn yuán dì xiǎng le hěn jiǔ tū rán xiǎng dào yí ge hǎo zhǔ yi

sentences.simplified: “他想要一个公主，那我找一个人来做‘公主’不就好了吗？”
sentences.traditional: “他想要一個公主，那我找一個人來做‘公主’不就好了嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng yào yí ge gōng zhǔ nà wǒ zhǎo yí ge rén lái zuò gōng zhǔ bú jiù hǎo le ma
sentences.english: Emperor Yuan thought for a long time and suddenly came up with a good idea:

sentences.simplified: 于是，他就去问皇宫里的下人，也就是宫女，愿不愿意去塞外和匈奴王结婚。
sentences.traditional: 於是，他就去問皇宮裡的下人，也就是宮女，願不願意去塞外和匈奴王結婚。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā jiù qù wèn huáng gōng lǐ de xià rén yě jiù shì gōng nǚ yuàn bú yuàn yì qù sài wài hé xiōng nú wáng jié hūn
sentences.english: “He wants a princess. So, can just find someone to be a ‘princess’, right?”

sentences.simplified: 可让人诧异的是，这些宫女也不愿意去塞外——
sentences.traditional: 可讓人詫異的是，這些宮女也不願意去塞外——
sentences.pinyin: kě ràng rén chà yì de shì zhè xiē gōng nǚ yě bú yuàn yì qù sài wài
sentences.english: So he asked the servants in the palace, the palace maids, if they would like to cross the frontier and marry the king of the Xiongnu.

sentences.simplified: 是啊，就算不是真正的公主，她们也不想去塞外受苦。
sentences.traditional: 是啊，就算不是真正的公主，她們也不想去塞外受苦。
sentences.pinyin: shì a jiù suàn bú shì zhēn zhèng de gōng zhǔ tā men yě bù xiǎng qù sài wài shòu kǔ
sentences.english: But astonishingly, these palace maids were also not willing to cross the frontier.
That’s right, even though they were not real princesses, they did not want to live a hard life beyond the frontier.

sentences.simplified: 很多天以后，汉元帝急得不行，才听说有一个宫女表示她愿意去。
sentences.traditional: 很多天以後，漢元帝急得不行，才聽說有一個宮女表示她願意去。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō tiān yǐ hòu hàn yuán dì jí de bù xíng cái tīng shuō yǒu yí ge gōng nǚ biǎo shì tā yuàn yì qù

sentences.simplified: 汉元帝十分欣慰，又十分感动。
sentences.traditional: 漢元帝十分欣慰，又十分感動。
sentences.pinyin: hàn yuán dì shí fēn xīn wèi yòu shí fēn gǎn dòng
sentences.english: Many days later, Emperor Yuan was feeling extremely anxious when he heard that a palace maid had expressed her willingness to go.

sentences.simplified: 他立刻同意了这件事，并请这个宫女来见他。
sentences.traditional: 他立刻同意了這件事，並請這個宮女來見他。
sentences.pinyin: tā lì kè tóng yì le zhè jiàn shì bìng qǐng zhè ge gōng nǚ lái jiàn tā
sentences.english: Emperor Yuan was extremely relieved and moved.
He immediately agreed to the matter and invited this palace maid to come to him.

sentences.simplified: 汉元帝一看到这个叫王昭君的宫女，马上就后悔了。因为这个女孩，真是太漂亮了！
sentences.traditional: 漢元帝一看到這個叫王昭君的宮女，馬上就後悔了。因為這個女孩，真是太漂亮了！
sentences.pinyin: hàn yuán dì yí kàn dào zhè ge jiào wáng zhāo jūn de gōng nǚ mǎ shàng jiù hòu huǐ le yīn wèi zhè ge nǚ hái zhēn shì tài piào liang le

sentences.simplified: 他有那么多妻子，那么多宫女，却没有一个比王昭君漂亮！
sentences.traditional: 他有那麼多妻子，那麼多宮女，卻沒有一個比王昭君漂亮！
sentences.pinyin: tā yǒu nà me duō qī zi nà me duō gōng nǚ què méi yǒu yí ge bǐ wáng zhāo jūn piào liang
sentences.english: As soon as Emperor Yuan saw this palace maid named Wang Zhaojun, he immediately regretted it. Because this girl was incredibly beautiful!
He had so many wives and so many palace maids, but none of them were prettier than Wang Zhaojun!

sentences.simplified: 那么漂亮的女孩，为什么他从来没见过呢？
sentences.traditional: 那麼漂亮的女孩，為什麼他從來沒見過呢？
sentences.pinyin: nà me piào liang de nǚ hái wèi shén me tā cóng lái méi jiàn guò ne

sentences.simplified: 追究下去，汉元帝才知道，
sentences.traditional: 追究下去，漢元帝才知道，
sentences.pinyin: zhuī jiū xià qù hàn yuán dì cái zhī dào
sentences.english: Such a beautiful girl, why had he never seen her?

sentences.simplified: 原来他自己曾经想找美人来做宫女，各地的美人都被送过来。
sentences.traditional: 原來他自己曾經想找美人來做宮女，各地的美人都被送過來。
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái tā zì jǐ céng jīng xiǎng zhǎo měi rén lái zuò gōng nǚ gè dì de měi rén dōu bèi sòng guò lái
sentences.english: After looking into this matter, Emperor Yuan found out why.

sentences.simplified: 一千多个美女，汉元帝没有时间慢慢看，
sentences.traditional: 一千多個美女，漢元帝沒有時間慢慢看，
sentences.pinyin: yì qiān duō ge měi nǚ hàn yuán dì méi yǒu shí jiān màn man kàn
sentences.english: Previously, he had wanted to find beauties to be palace maids. Beauties from all over the country were sent over.

sentences.simplified: 就让画家给她们画画，并将画像送过来给自己选。
sentences.traditional: 就讓畫家給她們畫畫，並將畫像送過來給自己選。
sentences.pinyin: jiù ràng huà jiā gěi tā men huà huà bìng jiāng huà xiàng sòng guò lái gěi zì jǐ xuǎn
sentences.english: With more than a thousand beauties, Emperor Yuan did not have time to look at them carefully, ..

sentences.simplified: 画家谋求财富，就让美女们出钱，谁出得多，他就画得漂亮一些。
sentences.traditional: 畫家謀求財富，就讓美女們出錢，誰出得多，他就畫得漂亮一些。
sentences.pinyin: huà jiā móu qiú cái fù jiù ràng měi nǚ men chū qián shéi chū de duō tā jiù huà de piào liang yì xiē
sentences.english: .. so he had a painter paint them and send the portraits over so he could choose for himself.

sentences.simplified: 大家都想得到皇帝的青睐，只好给钱给画家，
sentences.traditional: 大家都想得到皇帝的青睞，只好給錢給畫家，
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā dōu xiǎng dé dào huáng dì de qīng lài zhǐ hǎo gěi qián gěi huà jiā
sentences.english: The painter sought wealth. So he had the beautiful women pay, and whoever paid more, he painted more beautifully.

sentences.simplified: 只有王昭君不愿意给钱。
sentences.traditional: 只有王昭君不願意給錢。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu wáng zhāo jūn bú yuàn yì gěi qián
sentences.english: Everyone wanted to get the emperor’s favor, so they had to give the painter money.

sentences.simplified: 画家不高兴了，把她画得很丑，
sentences.traditional: 畫家不高興了，把她畫得很醜，
sentences.pinyin: huà jiā bù gāo xìng le bǎ tā huà de hěn chǒu
sentences.english: Only Wang Zhaojun was not willing to give any money.

sentences.simplified: 所以汉元帝看到画像就不喜欢，从来没有见过王昭君。
sentences.traditional: 所以漢元帝看到畫像就不喜歡，從來沒有見過王昭君。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ hàn yuán dì kàn dào huà xiàng jiù bù xǐ huan cóng lái méi yǒu jiàn guò wáng zhāo jūn
sentences.english: The painter was upset and painted her ugly, ..
.. so Emperor Yuan disliked the portrait when he saw it and never actually saw Wang Zhaojun.

sentences.simplified: 知道了画家做的坏事，汉元帝很生气，不想让王昭君去塞外了。
sentences.traditional: 知道了畫家做的壞事，漢元帝很生氣，不想讓王昭君去塞外了。
sentences.pinyin: zhī dào le huà jiā zuò de huài shì hàn yuán dì hěn shēng qì bù xiǎng ràng wáng zhāo jūn qù sài wài le

sentences.simplified: 但王昭君不愿意埋没在宫里，
sentences.traditional: 但王昭君不願意埋沒在宮裡，
sentences.pinyin: dàn wáng zhāo jūn bú yuàn yì mái mò zài gōng lǐ
sentences.english: When he found out about the painter’s bad deed, Emperor Yuan was angry and didn’t want to allow Wang Zhaojun to cross the frontier.

sentences.simplified: 她说：“我愿意去和匈奴结婚，奉献出自己的一生。
sentences.traditional: 她說：“我願意去和匈奴結婚，奉獻出自己的一生。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō wǒ yuàn yì qù hé xiōng nú jié hūn fèng xiàn chū zì jǐ de yì shēng
sentences.english: But Wang Zhaojun was not willing to fall into oblivion in the palace.

sentences.simplified: 保护国家是男人的事，也是我们女人的事。”
sentences.traditional: 保護國家是男人的事，也是我們女人的事。”
sentences.pinyin: bǎo hù guó jiā shì nán rén de shì yě shì wǒ men nǚ rén de shì
sentences.english: She said, ”I am willing to go and marry the Xiongnu and dedicate my life.

sentences.simplified: 汉元帝虽然不舍得，但也实在找不出第二个愿意去塞外的女孩了，
sentences.traditional: 漢元帝雖然不捨得，但也實在找不出第二個願意去塞外的女孩了，
sentences.pinyin: hàn yuán dì suī rán bù shě de dàn yě shí zài zhǎo bù chū dì èr ge yuàn yì qù sài wài de nǚ hái le
sentences.english: Protecting our country is a man’s business, and it is also a woman’s business.”

sentences.simplified: 只能把王昭君封为“公主”，送她离开。
sentences.traditional: 只能把王昭君封為“公主”，送她離開。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ néng bǎ wáng zhāo jūn fēng wéi gōng zhǔ sòng tā lí kāi
sentences.english: Although Emperor Yuan did not want her to leave, he could not find another girl who was willing to cross the frontier.
So had no choice but to make Wang Zhaojun a “princess” and send her away.

sentences.simplified: 在一个秋高气爽的日子里，美丽的王昭君穿着红裙子，告别故土，抱着琵琶出发了。
sentences.traditional: 在一個秋高氣爽的日子裡，美麗的王昭君穿著紅裙子，告別故土，抱著琵琶出發了。
sentences.pinyin: zài yí ge qiū gāo qì shuǎng de rì zi lǐ měi lì de wáng zhāo jūn chuān zhe hóng qún zi gào bié gù tǔ bào zhe pí pa chū fā le

sentences.simplified: 一路上，她想到以后很难再回故土，心绪难平。
sentences.traditional: 一路上，她想到以後很難再回故土，心緒難平。
sentences.pinyin: yí lù shang tā xiǎng dào yǐ hòu hěn nán zài huí gù tǔ xīn xù nán píng
sentences.english: On a crisp autumn day, the beautiful Wang Zhaojun, wearing a red dress, said goodbye to her homeland and set off with a pipa in her hands.

sentences.simplified: 于是，她骑在马上，拨动琴弦，奏起了离别之曲。
sentences.traditional: 於是，她騎在馬上，撥動琴弦，奏起了離別之曲。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā qí zài mǎ shang bō dòng qín xián zòu qǐ le lí bié zhī qǔ
sentences.english: On the way, she thought about how difficult it would be to return to her homeland, and she felt uneasy.

sentences.simplified: 南飞的大雁听到这悦耳的琴声，看到骑在马上的这个美丽女子，
sentences.traditional: 南飛的大雁聽到這悅耳的琴聲，看到騎在馬上的這個美麗女子，
sentences.pinyin: nán fēi de dà yàn tīng dào zhè yuè ěr de qín shēng kàn dào qí zài mǎ shang de zhè ge měi lì nǚ zǐ
sentences.english: So, as she rode on her horse, she plucked the strings and played a parting tune.

sentences.simplified: 忘记摆动翅膀，跌落地下。
sentences.traditional: 忘記擺動翅膀，跌落地下。
sentences.pinyin: wàng jì bǎi dòng chì bǎng diē luò dì xià
sentences.english: When geese flying south heard the sweet-sounding pipa and saw the beautiful woman riding on a horse, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以，后来王昭君有了“落雁”的美称。
sentences.traditional: 所以，後來王昭君有了“落雁”的美稱。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ hòu lái wáng zhāo jūn yǒu le luò yàn de měi chēng
sentences.english: ..  they forgot to flap their wings and fell to the ground.
Therefore, Wang Zhaojun was subsequently known as “Wild Geese Drop”.

sentences.traditional: 馬車經過了茫茫的大漠，經過了荒涼的草原，

sentences.simplified: 从冬天走到夏天，才走到了塞外，匈奴的地方。
sentences.traditional: 從冬天走到夏天，才走到了塞外，匈奴的地方。
sentences.pinyin: cóng dōng tiān zǒu dào xià tiān cái zǒu dào le sài wài xiōng nú de dì fang
sentences.english: The carriage passed through vast deserts and passed through desolate grasslands.

sentences.simplified: 呼韩邪感谢着汉朝，一直对王昭君很好。
sentences.traditional: 呼韓邪感謝著漢朝，一直對王昭君很好。
sentences.pinyin: hū hán yé gǎn xiè zhe hàn cháo yì zhí duì wáng zhāo jūn hěn hǎo
sentences.english: It traveled from winter to summer before it arrived beyond the frontier in the Xiongnu’s territory.

sentences.simplified: 他死了以后，他以前的儿子又按规定当了匈奴王，还和继母王昭君结了婚。
sentences.traditional: 他死了以後，他以前的兒子又按規定當了匈奴王，還和繼母王昭君結了婚。
sentences.pinyin: tā sǐ le yǐ hòu tā yǐ qián de ér zi yòu àn guī dìng dāng le xiōng nú wáng hái hé jì mǔ wáng zhāo jūn jié le hūn
sentences.english: Huhanye was grateful to the Han Dynasty and was always kind to Wang Zhaojun.
After his death, according to the rules, his son from previously became king of the Xiongnu and also married his stepmother Wang Zhaojun.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，王昭君先后和两个匈奴王结婚。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，王昭君先後和兩個匈奴王結婚。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng wáng zhāo jūn xiān hòu hé liǎng ge xiōng nú wáng jié hūn

sentences.simplified: 她的到来，让匈奴和汉朝维持了六十年的和平。
sentences.traditional: 她的到來，讓匈奴和漢朝維持了六十年的和平。
sentences.pinyin: tā de dào lái ràng xiōng nú hé hàn cháo wéi chí le liù shí nián de hé píng
sentences.english: In this way, Wang Zhaojun married two Xiongnu kings in succession.
Her arrival kept peace between Xiongnu and the Han Dynasty for 60 years.

sentences.simplified: 王昭君的善良、坚强和友好，像太阳一般照耀在匈奴的土地上。
sentences.traditional: 王昭君的善良、堅強和友好，像太陽一般照耀在匈奴的土地上。

sentence_translations: Zhaojun Crosses the Frontier
There were many beautiful women in ancient China. The four most famous were known as the “Four Beauties”.
They were also known by the monkier: “Fish Sink and Wild Geese Drop, to Outshine the Moon and Put the Flowers to Shame”.
They changed the destiny of the nation. Some led the nation to great chaos, and some led the nation to unification.
The “Wild Geese Drop“ among the “Four Beauties” was named Wang Zhaojun.
She was from the Han Dynasty and married the king of the Xiongnu.
The Xiongnu had been around the Han Dynasty for hundreds of years.
Since the land was not suitable for farming, they had to come and plunder food from the Han Dynasty.
Only after Emperor Wu of Han sent people to give them a beating did they restrain themselves a little.
Later, during the time of Emperor Xuan of Han, the Xiongnu themselves were caught up in a civil war.
Five chiefs were vying to be king of the Xiongnu, and none of them were willing to give up.
Moreover, some of these people intended to continue to fight against the Han Dynasty, ..
.. while others wanted to “make friends” with the Han Dynasty.
Their ideas were very different.
Unable to negotiate, they would use their fists to talk, and the fighting never ceased.
Finally, only two leaders remained⁠—Zhizhi Chanyu of the Northern Xiongnu and Huhanye Chanyu of the Southern Xiongnu.
Of these two factions, one wanted to fight the Han Dynasty, and the other wanted to be on friendly terms with the Han Dynasty.
Unfortunately, Huhanye of the Southern Xiongnu, who wanted friendly relations with the Han Dynasty, could not defeat the Northern Xiongnu.
As a result, he decided to surrender to the Han Dynasty and ask for help.
In this way, he came to the Han dynasty in person and met Emperor Xuan.
His surrender made the whole Han dynasty very happy. How savage the Xiongnu used to be, and now they finally surrender!
Emperor Xuan received Huhanye warmly, invited him to dinner and entertainment, and then also sent 16,000 soldiers to see him back.
There were many soldiers, each on horseback, carrying gifts and food. With their help, Huhanye regained the throne.
Huhanye was very fond of the Han Dynasty. After the death of Emperor Xuan, he wanted to continue such friendly relations.
So, after a few years, he returned to visit Emperor Yuan of Han.
This time he said sincerely, ”I want to marry a princess of the Han Dynasty and be your son-in-law.”
Emperor Yuan was very happy, but his daughters were very young, and Huhanye was already 50 years old.
None of the princesses wanted to leave the flourishing Han Dynasty and live a hard life beyond the frontier, ..
.. nor did they want to marry an old man.
Emperor Yuan thought for a long time and suddenly came up with a good idea:
“He wants a princess. So, can just find someone to be a ‘princess’, right?”
So he asked the servants in the palace, the palace maids, if they would like to cross the frontier and marry the king of the Xiongnu.
But astonishingly, these palace maids were also not willing to cross the frontier.
That’s right, even though they were not real princesses, they did not want to live a hard life beyond the frontier.
Many days later, Emperor Yuan was feeling extremely anxious when he heard that a palace maid had expressed her willingness to go.
Emperor Yuan was extremely relieved and moved.
He immediately agreed to the matter and invited this palace maid to come to him.
As soon as Emperor Yuan saw this palace maid named Wang Zhaojun, he immediately regretted it. Because this girl was incredibly beautiful!
He had so many wives and so many palace maids, but none of them were prettier than Wang Zhaojun!
Such a beautiful girl, why had he never seen her?
After looking into this matter, Emperor Yuan found out why.
Previously, he had wanted to find beauties to be palace maids. Beauties from all over the country were sent over.
With more than a thousand beauties, Emperor Yuan did not have time to look at them carefully, ..
.. so he had a painter paint them and send the portraits over so he could choose for himself.
The painter sought wealth. So he had the beautiful women pay, and whoever paid more, he painted more beautifully.
Everyone wanted to get the emperor’s favor, so they had to give the painter money.
Only Wang Zhaojun was not willing to give any money.
The painter was upset and painted her ugly, ..
.. so Emperor Yuan disliked the portrait when he saw it and never actually saw Wang Zhaojun.
When he found out about the painter’s bad deed, Emperor Yuan was angry and didn’t want to allow Wang Zhaojun to cross the frontier.
But Wang Zhaojun was not willing to fall into oblivion in the palace.
She said, ”I am willing to go and marry the Xiongnu and dedicate my life.
Protecting our country is a man’s business, and it is also a woman’s business.”
Although Emperor Yuan did not want her to leave, he could not find another girl who was willing to cross the frontier.
So had no choice but to make Wang Zhaojun a “princess” and send her away.
On a crisp autumn day, the beautiful Wang Zhaojun, wearing a red dress, said goodbye to her homeland and set off with a pipa in her hands.
On the way, she thought about how difficult it would be to return to her homeland, and she felt uneasy.
So, as she rode on her horse, she plucked the strings and played a parting tune.
When geese flying south heard the sweet-sounding pipa and saw the beautiful woman riding on a horse, ..
..  they forgot to flap their wings and fell to the ground.
Therefore, Wang Zhaojun was subsequently known as “Wild Geese Drop”.
The carriage passed through vast deserts and passed through desolate grasslands.
It traveled from winter to summer before it arrived beyond the frontier in the Xiongnu’s territory.
Huhanye was grateful to the Han Dynasty and was always kind to Wang Zhaojun.
After his death, according to the rules, his son from previously became king of the Xiongnu and also married his stepmother Wang Zhaojun.
In this way, Wang Zhaojun married two Xiongnu kings in succession.
Her arrival kept peace between Xiongnu and the Han Dynasty for 60 years.
Wang Zhaojun’s kindness, strength, and friendliness shone like the sun in the land of Xiongnu.
By imperceptible influence, the Xiongnu began to learn how to plant fields and trees and raise livestock from the Han Dynasty, ..
.. and lived a better life.
Wang Zhaojun was so beautiful, and even more laudable was the peace and stability she brought to the Han Dynasty.
She really deserves to be called one of the “Four Beauties”!
